supersedes.specificationSha256Note: The specification digest the prior approval named, and the digest the historical participant-delivery review still pins. It is kept here so custody of the superseded approval stays exact without any control claiming it describes the current specification.
supersedes.why: The shared §7 Fees & costs correction changed what the Last verified slot prints, which moved this route's full EN and full ES bytes. The superseded decision names the pre-correction digests and cannot be edited to describe bytes it never saw, so it is preserved exactly as signed. Its court-only digest is unchanged, because the court-only variant carries no guide -- that is a fact about the bytes, not a reason to treat the superseded decision as still current.

accountedForBy.note: The move record that held this route while no approval existed. It created no approval and creates none now; this decision is the approval, and the move record is the history of the interval between them.

packetContentsChange.whatChanged: The §7 supplemental guide's "Last verified / Official source" cell no longer prints the route-level "Not established for this route - ask the clerk or filing office" sentence in the half that holds a verification date. Where no date is recorded it prints "Not recorded" / "No registrado", beside the official source unchanged. Nothing else about the packet's contents changed: the same documents, the same guide sections, the same supersession of ms-filing-and-next-steps.
